findings.location: source.html paragraph: "What lay behind those flashing eyes, and what memories are stored beneath his ever-crowning beanie?"
findings.source_quote: What lay behind those flashing eyes, and what memories are stored beneath his ever-crowning beanie?
findings.suggested_fix: Preserve meaning and improve Norwegian idiom: replace “den stadig pålagte lue” with a clearer phrase such as “den stadig brukte lua” or “lua han alltid hadde på seg.” Keep existing HTML tags and structure.
findings.translation_quote: Hva lå bak de blafrende øynene, og hvilke minner var lagret under den stadig pålagte lue?

findings.location: source.html paragraph: "He had his fellow beach bums, but he was still alone inside."
findings.source_quote: He had his fellow beach bums, but he was still alone inside.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a natural Norwegian rendering for “beach bums.” Replace “sine med-strandløse” with e.g. “sine medstrandskamerater” or “andre strandløse” (better: “sine strandkamerater” or “de andre på stranden”). Preserve the surrounding HTML.
findings.translation_quote: Han hadde sine med-strandløse, men han var fortsatt alene innvendig.
